frozen.clause: none: no row of TASK-083 fires a clause; nothing in TASK-077's scope is closed or reopened

combination.at_least_one: no 'at least one seed' statement is a claim
combination.claim: REP-PASS: both seeds reach L-PASS individually (an intersection-union test; no multiplicity adjustment needed or applied; no joint test)
combination.pooling: never: the seeds' counts are not summed or averaged into a test, and a seed is not rescued by the other seed, by W-66800 on this cohort or by TASK-081's earlier pass
combination.shared: the seeds share the comparator, L-rand and the ceiling on the same resets, so their rows are not independent

combined_rows.REP-NONE: neither seed L-PASS: not replicated with either seed; at the declared power a non-pass is weak evidence against TASK-081's result unless a seed is L-NO-GAIN or L-INFERIOR
combined_rows.REP-ONE: exactly one seed L-PASS: not replicated; stated factually (which seed passed, which did not, rows and counts); at the declared power this does not show whether seed or chance caused the difference unless the other seed is L-NO-GAIN or L-INFERIOR
combined_rows.REP-PASS: both seeds L-PASS: TASK-081's L-PASS replicates across W's model seeds of this training run
combined_rows.V: one repeat of Stage S after a recorded fix

frozen.delegated: decided by Claude under owner delegation (2026-09-30)

quiet_machine.rule: os.getloadavg() at the stage's start: the 1- and 5-minute load averages are both at most 2.0 (the idle machine with the GPU's resident service measures about 0.1-0.4); otherwise G-quiet makes the stage V before any render

r7_by_row.REP-NONE: R7 adds that the result did not replicate with either other seed (rows, counts), with the same power caveat
r7_by_row.REP-ONE: R7 adds, factually, which seed passed and which did not (rows and counts), and that at the declared power this does not show whether seed or chance caused the difference unless the other seed is L-NO-GAIN or L-INFERIOR
r7_by_row.REP-PASS: R7 adds the replication: both other seeds L-PASS, each seed's count, interval and comparator difference, every qualifier kept (the flags with the last-point caveat, the solver's effect not shown); H-rule measurably better stated per seed
r7_by_row.every_reading_row: a seed at L-NO-GAIN or L-INFERIOR is stated with 'detectably'; W-66800's count on this cohort is stated, reported only, whatever it is; TASK-081's L-PASS stands

rows.L-BAR: G-bar fails with G-NI and the tests passing: escalate, no clause, no claim
rows.L-INFERIOR: W is detectably inferior beyond delta (upper bound of W - C < -16/128): detectably not replicated
rows.L-NEAR: G-NI fails, W not detectably inferior: escalate, no clause, no claim
rows.L-NO-GAIN: for a twin, the McNemar test fails and W is detectably no better (upper bound of W - arm < +7 resets): detectably not replicated
rows.L-PASS: G-bar, G-NI and the four McNemar tests pass: the primary claim, 'LeWM-driven closed-loop success'
rows.L-TWIN-NEAR: a McNemar test fails and every failed one is a miss within noise: escalate, no clause, no claim
rows.S-VOID-CEILING: H-final(commit)(S) < 112/128: escalate, no clause, no claim
rows.V: one repeat of the stage after a recorded fix

solver.fallback: the grid argmin, on fewer than 4 points, |det(I - J)| < 1e-6 or an infeasible chunk at the clipped fixed point
solver.name: affine_local

void_rule.debug: debug runs only on committed code, only on 75900-75999; nothing in them is read
void_rule.repeat: a V in any pool voids the whole of Stage S; at most one repeat, after a committed, pushed and recorded fix, re-running every pool and arm on the same seeds in a new output directory; a second V ends TASK-083 INCONCLUSIVE; any repeat after a non-pass row needs fresh seeds and its own ruling
void_rule.void: any guard, crash, cap, stop signal or CUDA allocation failure makes a stage V; its report is kept with its sha256 and the cause disclosed
